language.headingHint: Choose your launcher and game language.
language.autoSave: Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
language.gameHint: Only complete, locally installed official language packs are listed. Changes apply on the next launch.
language.gameSaving: Checking and saving the game language…
language.gameSaved: Game language saved. It will apply on the next launch.
language.gameLoadError: Could not read language packs or the game language preference. Refresh to retry.
language.gameSaveError: Could not save the game language. Check folder permissions and free disk space.
language.gameUnavailable: This official language pack is not fully installed. Refresh the list after installing it.
language.gameCurrentUnavailable: The saved game language is not fully installed. Choose an available language.
language.gameEmpty: No complete official language packs were found. Install one through Battle.net, then refresh.
settings.cheatsHint: All cheats are disabled by default. Save or Launch applies your selection on the next game start.
settings.cheatsNotice: We strongly recommend completing the campaign once before enabling cheats.
settings.cheatHealthHint: Demigod lets you take damage but prevents normal death. God mode prevents normal damage. Neither prevents scripted deaths.
settings.cheatNotargetHint: Enemies ignore you as a target. Uses native notarget behavior; your character remains visible and scripted events can still occur.
settings.cheatAmmoHint: Infinite reserves keeps reserve ammo at 500; reloading and chambering still apply. Infinite ammo keeps loaded weapons ready after firing. Empty weapons still need to be loaded first.
settings.buildUnknown: Build information is unavailable until settings finish loading.
settings.buildOptimized: {configuration}: optimized for gameplay, with symbols retained for crash diagnosis. Optional probes below can still add overhead.
settings.buildDebug: {configuration}: unoptimized development build. Compiler debugging checks remain active when these probes are off. Use an optimized build to measure frame rate.
settings.debugHint: Optional probes can reduce frame rate. All are off by default. Save or Launch applies your selection on the next game start.
settings.debugViewHint: Capture call stacks, memory hashes, view changes and detailed backend events on the render path.
settings.debugMenuInputHint: Record 30-second menu input windows at startup and after tracking recovery; save CSV reports automatically.
settings.debugWeaponEventsHint: Record native ammunition, reload and equipment transitions for status and diagnostic reports.
settings.debugVehicleHint: Keep recent snowmobile steering samples. Export with vr_vehicle_steering_trace.
settings.debugReloadWellHint: Show magazine insertion bounds and the simulation decision in both eyes.
settings.debugHkSlapHint: Show hand contacts, the motion cone and the latest handle slap decision.
settings.debugBoltHint: Show the handle path, ejection threshold, rear stop and hand eligibility.
settings.debugCoverHint: Show cover contact and rearm regions with the authoritative push decision.
settings.debugSnapshotsHint: Periodically collect and write large status reports and available probe evidence. Manual status and crash reports remain available when off.
settings.debugPerfHint: Load scene job timing probes. In game, use vr_perfStart and vr_perfStop to record a bounded capture.
settings.debugSceneModelsHint: Investigate disappearing equipment and scene surface limits. Records only during a capture started with vr_perfStart 30.
settings.recordingModeHint: Show the capture angle in both eyes with a white frame, dimmed surroundings and a hint below. The left eye approximates the right-eye capture. These guides stay outside the desktop capture.
settings.recordingDimHint: 0 keeps exterior brightness; 100 makes it fully black. Default: 65. Applies while live stream preview is enabled.
settings.comfortHint: A clearer view through your headset.
settings.cameraBobHint: Walking, running, crouching and crawling motion, including empty hands and knife.
settings.disableFlaresHint: Reduce bright lens effects in VR.
settings.offsetHint: Move your hand and its rotation center together. Adjustments use your recentered forward reference and remain stable when you turn your wrist. Inward is mirrored per hand.
settings.offsetRange: Adjustment range: -0.5 to 0.5 meters per axis.
settings.rotationHint: Fine-tune hand and weapon angles for both controllers. Positive pitch tilts up, yaw turns left, and roll tilts the right side down. Set all three to 0 to remove angle correction.
settings.rotationRange: Adjustment range: -180 to 180 degrees per axis.
settings.turningHint: Choose how the controller turns your view.
settings.aimHint: Gently guide shots toward visible enemies near your barrel direction. 0 turns assistance off; 50 allows 5 degrees, 100 allows 10 degrees.
settings.chamberingGuideHint: Highlight chambering controls in opaque yellow when a loaded weapon needs chambering. Off by default.
settings.physicalLaddersHint: Grip a rung and pull to climb. Release both hands to let go. Turn off to use native ladder controls. On by default.
settings.quickReloadHint: Hold an empty, compatible weapon at your waist for 1 second to reload from reserves. Chamber manually.
settings.throwSpeedHint: Adjust throwable speed. 1× is the standard throw strength.
settings.recoilHint: Control the extra recoil when firing one-handed.
settings.noRecoilHint: Disable muzzle recoil when firing. Off by default.
common.previewHint: Preview only. Not saved or applied to gameplay.
settings.ammoDropHint: Lose all remaining rounds in discarded magazines. Release held magazines at your waist to recover their rounds. Off by default.
language.name: English
language.loadError: Could not read the launcher language. English is used until you retry or choose a language.
language.saveError: Could not save the launcher language. Check folder permissions and free disk space.
language.unsupported: This launcher language is not available.
status.dirty: Unsaved changes. Save now or launch the game to apply.
status.saved: Saved. These settings will be used on the next launch.
error.readConfig: Could not read the game configuration.
error.largeConfig: The game configuration is too large to edit safely.
error.textConfig: The game configuration is not a valid text file.
error.invalidVR: Check the VR setting values and allowed ranges.
error.disk: Could not save VR settings. Check folder permissions and free disk space.
settings.stabilizationHint: Independent options, all off by default. Strength 0 bypasses filtering.
settings.desktopStabilizationHint: Smooth turning, pitching and rolling in the desktop view. Reserves 15% of the tangent extent for stabilization.
settings.headStabilizationHint: Light position and rotation filtering. May add tracking lag or discomfort; reduce strength or switch off if uncomfortable.
settings.handStabilizationHint: Smooth hands, held weapons, aiming and interactions together. Fast movements reduce filtering.
settings.enemyMeleeDamageHint: 0.1–2.0× · Default 0.5×. Includes dog bites. 1× restores original damage.
settings.disableDogPounceHint: On by default. Dogs still bite, but do not pin the player down.
settings.hideHudHint: Hide game HUD and 3D HUD. Menus remain visible.
settings.disableBlurHint: Disable fullscreen and HUD background blur.
help.storyWarning: Contains spoilers. View at your own risk.
help.searchHint: Search all topics by weapon, action or mission name. Story tips are included after acknowledging the spoiler notice.
help.noResults: No matching entries. Try a weapon name or shorter keyword; open Story interactions and acknowledge the spoiler notice for mission entries.
oobe.quickGuideHint: Revisit language, device, comfort, assistance and challenge preferences.
oobe.languageHint: A few choices to get started. You can change them later in VR Settings.
oobe.languageNote: Choose the launcher display language. Game text and audio stay unchanged.
oobe.deviceHint: Match your controllers, then choose how you turn.
oobe.deviceNote: Quest 3 applies its hand alignment preset. For other devices, start without a preset and adjust alignment later in Basics.
oobe.comfortHint: Adjust small movements and visual effects to suit your comfort.
oobe.assistanceHint: Choose the help you want with weapon handling and aiming.
oobe.challengeHint: Decide how demanding weapon handling should be.
oobe.finishHint: You're ready to play. Select Finish to return to the launcher.
oobe.finishNote: Return to this guide anytime from VR Settings > Basics. The Help page explains movement, interactions and weapon handling.
error.gameDirectory: Place Overlord in a supported game directory before saving VR settings.
oobe.turnHelp: Smooth turns continuously while you hold the stick. Snap turns by a fixed angle each time.
oobe.turnSpeedHelp: Degrees per second during smooth turning. Higher values turn faster.
oobe.snapAngleHelp: Degrees per snap. Smaller angles make each turn finer.
oobe.headHelp: Smooth small headset movements. This can add tracking delay; switch it off if it feels uncomfortable.
oobe.handHelp: Smooth hands, weapons and aiming together. Filtering eases during fast movements.
oobe.flareHelp: Remove bright lens flares to keep the headset view clearer.
oobe.blurHelp: Remove fullscreen and HUD background blur.
oobe.bobHelp: Add camera motion while walking, running and changing stance. Switch it off to reduce movement-induced bobbing.
oobe.chamberHelp: When a loaded weapon needs chambering, highlight the bolt, charging handle or release control in yellow.
oobe.reloadHelp: For supported weapons, remove the magazine or open and empty the weapon, then hold it at your waist for 1 second to refill. Chamber manually.
oobe.aimHelp: Guide shots toward visible enemies near the muzzle direction. 0 is off; 50 allows up to 5 degrees of correction, 100 up to 10 degrees.
oobe.penaltyHelp: With muzzle recoil enabled, add extra recoil to the selected weapons when firing one-handed. Off removes only this extra penalty.
oobe.ammoHelp: Discarded magazines lose their remaining rounds. Release held magazines at your waist to recover those rounds.
settings.runtimeBackendHint: OpenXR is recommended; OpenVR is a backup. Saved immediately and used when you enter the game; no launcher restart needed.
